digest.component_or_area: reconciler JIRA adapter/credential surface config-ownership cutover
propositions: 12 below-seam ambient config reads in reconciler JIRA adapter files flagged by AST gate as `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` must be migrated to owned resolvers or marked in-place.

11 composed-config reads (JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT and reconciler knobs) must be routed through owned `config.py`/`_config_sources.py` resolvers with live-per-call evaluation to preserve env-over-file precedence.

Secret credential reads (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) remain owner=credential and unchanged; non-secret composition reads (JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT) must move from owner=composition to owner=credential boundary via owned resolvers.
REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE subsystem debug switch must be owned-in-place via `# read-via:` marker as the sole marked read; all other listed reads must be cut-to-seam.
All 12 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows must be removed from `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py` and `check_config_ownership.py` must pass with zero path-glob exceptions after the cutover.

Behavioral regressions (JIRA endpoint live-precedence, insecure-url fail-loud, acli timeout clamp, rich_text/wiki_render ImportError→default degrade) must be preserved through owned resolver delegation and verified via test suite.
